executor.thread_title: Goose Sim2Sim 训练任务 Picking

question: Can the sealed04 physical beak make and retain a100g pure-contact grasp, and which observed gap relative to the old Pickup setup explains any failure?
preflight: Verify archive checksum and isolated source identity; do not edit sealed inputs.
Audit full physical object geometry/COM/inertia and the12mm handle baseline, not only the grasp stem.
Report old/new jaw geometry, effective contact parameters/condim, solver options, MCI, named axis mapping, passive linkage, force application and50Hz command/200Hz torque/physics timing.
Read actual drive torques and enforce continuous torque-speed/voltage/350W positive mechanical envelope, peak disabled.

Save control source/version, actual object/robot initial poses, contact admission and scene hashes before attempts. If unadmitted, return the reason instead of silently substituting old ribs or friction.

pilot.claim: exploratory local grip only; no robust success rate, full pickup, backdrag or hardware qualification
pilot.fixture_boundary: Explicitly label fixed-head/body rigs, their changed constraints and reactions; retain free payload. Such data do not qualify a free robot.

allowed_changes: Lab-owned experimental scene and logging/replay harness
Declared bounded control requests through the frozen drive envelope
Explicitly labelled fixture and negative-control scenes; record their differences from the free robot
prohibited_changes: Robot CAD/mesh/collision/material/physical or actuator contract changes
Old crowned ribs,condim6,friction or solver tuning silently imported into04
Payload attachment/adhesion, online object position edits, unreported root support
GPU use, training updates, additional concurrent experiment executors
Restoring prior long-term training or automated wakeups
required_return: Acceptance time/deadline and actual resource usage/exit receipt
Input/engine/controller/scene/object/source hashes, read-back hardware invariants and reproducible entry command
Preflight differences and admission decisions, actual attempt counts including failures
Per-physics-step state, grip relative pose, contacts/6D wrench/penetration, applied torque/speed/power/limits, drift and warnings
Raw continuous1x video bound to actual trajectory; if rendering unavailable, retain actual data and state the missing video explicitly
Structured summary of pass/fail/unexecuted, precise first failure, diagnostic versus whole-robot scope and next smallest discriminating test

return_to.method: Write self-contained result package in Lab compliant outputs and final response with absolute paths; PM reads/waits this same chat.

stop: Return at3600s or sooner when the scoped question is answered/admission fails; preserve evidence and stop. No automatic extra batch.
